kubejs.ponder.tag.liminal_industries_pon: Demonstrations related to Liminal Industries: Rescripted content
kubejs.ponder.inspecting_carpet.text_1: A spyglass will show you if truffles can be harvested from a carpet
kubejs.ponder.inspecting_carpet.text_2: "The carpet here looks thoroughly picked over."
kubejs.ponder.inspecting_carpet.text_3: If it appears anything but undisturbed, it's best to search somewhere else
kubejs.ponder.inspecting_carpet.text_5: Carpets will return to an undisturbed state if you pick at other areas enough
kubejs.ponder.searching_for_truffles.tex: To search for a truffle, crawl and hold right click on a carpet
After enough clicks, a truffle will pop out
You cannot get truffles from the same area twice*
